info.title: Secret Workbench — local GUI for ASP.NET Core user secrets
info.description: A local GUI for viewing and bulk-editing ASP.NET Core user secrets.

options.name: --root
options.description: Initial folder to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port. Use 0 for an available dynamic port (default).

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the default browser automatically.
